contracts_defined: tests/observed-routing.test.mjs header block (lines 1-94) — Phase S1 observed-routing contract surface: (a) extractObservedRouting(events) walks the child's JSON event stream and returns the served model from the first message_start whose message.model is populated, or undefined; (b) classifyObservedRouting(pin, observedModel) returns {class: 'verified_routing'} on match (after MODEL_MAP resolution), {class: 'unverified_routing', reason: 'observed_routing_mismatch', requestedModel, observedModel} on mismatch, {class: 'unverified_routing', reason: 'observed_routing_unobservable'} on undefined observed; (c) runtimeModelStrict(agent) returns {model} or {error: {class: 'undeclared_child_pin', role}}, NEVER falls back to a parent model; (d) computeRoleDefinitionHash(systemPrompt) returns sha256(systemPrompt.trim()) — separate from promptHash; (e) resolveStrict(requestedModel, observedModel) is strict equality after MODEL_MAP resolution — no alias widening; (f) classifyAgentFile(filePath, lstat) returns {class: 'symlinked_agent_file', path} when lstat indicates a symlink, null otherwise; (g) buildReceipt({pin, roleDefinition, promptBody, events}) composes a receipt with requestedModel, observedModel, roleDefinitionHash, promptHash, failureClassification (undefined on match), verifiedRouting ({class, reason?} structure).
